title: “We’ve started calling greed ‘good management,’ pride ‘confidence,’ and self-interest ‘wisdom.’ Funny how sin looks respectable when it wears a suit and smiles from a pulpit.”
paragraphs: “We’ve started calling greed ‘good management,’ pride ‘confidence,’ and self-interest ‘wisdom.’ Funny how sin looks respectable when it wears a suit and smiles from a pulpit.”

1 Timothy 6:10 (NIV)
“For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some people, eager for money, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.”
